_meta.source: British eDom norms (Armstrong et al., 2012; British extension)
_meta.description: British English homonym dominance norms — 100 words with two meanings each, frequency ratings from native BrE speakers

fields.dominant_meaning: Which meaning is more frequent (1 or 2)
fields.balanced: True if B < 0.40 — high ambiguity risk for AAC
fields.relatedness: How related the two meanings are (1=unrelated, 7=related)
fields.senses: Number of word senses in WordNet

_meta.usage: Import into BCI classification to flag ambiguous words and guide symbol selection. Words with balanced=true need context disambiguation.
